requestKey.description: Optional retry key for this exact update within 24 hours.

meetingPrep.description: Markdown prep; null or empty string clears it until regenerated, omission preserves it.

attendeeEmails.description: Complete replacement attendee list for an ended meeting; [] clears the list, omission preserves it.

privacySetting.description: Configured privacy; omitted preserves it and null is not accepted.

transcriptFileId.description: Completed file ID to attach if needed and make canonical; omission preserves the current transcript; clearing is unsupported.

postMeetingSummary.description: Markdown summary; null or empty string clears it until regenerated, omission preserves it.

FunctionInput_lightfield_updatemeeting.description: Partial meeting update with at least one writable field or canonical transcript selection.

httpLink.description: Web-app link or null; absent stays absent.

createdAt.description: Record creation instant in UTC Z.

updatedAt.description: Update instant in UTC, or null; omitted if absent.

additionalProperties.description: Unwrapped field value, preserving scalar, string-array, structured, and null values.

attributes.description: Privacy-aware unwrapped field values, including manual attendee change fields when returned; datetime attributes are UTC instants.

externalId.description: External identity or null; absent stays absent.

relationships.description: Visible relationship keys and related IDs, preserving canonical and all-transcript distinctions.

attributeTypes.description: Value types keyed identically to attributes.

FunctionOutput_lightfield_updatemeeting.description: Privacy-aware updated meeting with unwrapped attributes and UTC datetime values.

tags.instructions: Get meetingId from `list-meetings` or `get-meeting`. Only participants and admins can edit. Attendee replacement is allowed only after the meeting ends and can hide the meeting if an address is blocked; only an admin removing that block can bring it back. Complete any transcript upload first. Prep and summary edits may be replaced by later automatic regeneration. Omitted fields stay unchanged; transcripts cannot be cleared.

functions.name: update-note
functions.description: Partially edit a note's title or Markdown body and add or remove related-record associations without replacing unrelated links.

title.description: Replacement title; omission preserves it, empty string is sent literally and may be rejected by business validation.

content.description: Replacement Unicode Markdown body; empty string clears it, omission preserves it; null unsupported.

requestKey.description: Optional retry key for this exact edit within 24 hours.

relationshipChanges.description: Association edits by account/contact/meeting/opportunity or custom bare slug; omitted relationships remain unchanged.

add.description: Existing active related IDs to add without removing other links.

remove.description: Related IDs whose associations should be removed, not records to delete.

items.description: Related record ID whose association is to be removed.

additionalProperties.description: Specific additions and removals for one relationship.

FunctionInput_lightfield_updatenote.description: Partial note edit with at least one supplied text field or relationship change.

content.description: Returned Markdown body as Unicode text, preserving empty/null/absence.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC Z.

updatedAt.description: Update instant in UTC or null; omitted if absent.

externalId.description: External identity, preserving null/absence.

relationships.description: Returned related IDs by friendly system key or unchanged custom slug.

FunctionOutput_lightfield_updatenote.description: Updated note returned by Lightfield, with unwrapped text and normalized timestamps.

tags.instructions: Get noteId from `list-notes` or `get-note`. Omitted text and relationships stay unchanged. Empty content clears the body; null is not accepted. Add/remove specific links using relationshipChanges; replacement of the full relationship set is unsupported. At most 25 links may be changed per call. Use `get-note-definitions` for custom keys and keep requestKey for identical retries.

functions.name: update-opportunity
functions.description: Partially modify an opportunity's supplied fields and associations, including stage/pipeline membership.

fields.description: Only supplied fields change. Use exact keys, including $name/$stage; null clears supported nullable fields; arrays/objects are whole field values.

additionalProperties.description: A supplied native field value or supported null clearing.

relationships.description: Only supplied operations change links. File links support add/remove, not replace.

add.description: IDs to associate; files must be completed and Slack links use Lightfield chn_ IDs.

remove.description: IDs to detach, without deleting related records.

replace.description: Set a supported single-valued relationship to this ID, or null to clear it.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional identity for replaying this exact update within 24 hours.

FunctionInput_lightfield_updateopportuni.description: An opportunity and the supplied partial field or relationship changes.

id.description: Updated opportunity ID, unchanged by modification.

value.description: Native value or null; address/full-name component map remains structured; DATETIME is UTC RFC 3339.

fields.description: Returned typed field values.

createdAt.description: Original creation instant in UTC Z.

updatedAt.description: Update instant in UTC Z or null.

externalId.description: External identifier, when returned.

relationships.description: Returned link IDs and metadata.

FunctionOutput_lightfield_updateopportun.description: The returned opportunity modification, not confirmation of summary regeneration.

tags.instructions: Find opportunityId through `list-opportunities` and writable keys/options through `get-opportunity-definitions`. Omitted values remain unchanged. Null only clears nullable fields or supported single-valued links. Use `delete-opportunity` to trash the record. At most 25 referenced IDs and 25 changed links are allowed per request.

functions.name: update-sequence-from-draft
functions.description: Publish the exact reviewed draft revision; enrolled contacts continue on the new version.

FunctionInput_lightfield_updatesequencef.description: Sequence and exact reviewed draft revision to publish.

status.description: Sending state after publication; first publish is DEACTIVATED.

FunctionOutput_lightfield_updatesequence.description: Publication receipt identifying the sequence and its sending state.

tags.instructions: Read `get-sequence-draft` and publishWarnings first. Publication can change existing contacts' cadence. Pass its exact version; no silent refresh occurs. First publication leaves sending paused; call `enable-sequence` separately to start sending.

functions.name: update-task
functions.description: Partially update task fields and singular associations without rewriting omitted data.

dueAt.description: Replacement deadline with explicit timezone; null clears, omission preserves; no rounding.

status.description: Replacement workflow status; omission preserves.

accountId.description: Replacement account; null clears, omission preserves.

requestKey.description: Optional unique key for retries of this exact update within 24 hours.

description.description: Replacement Markdown; null clears, empty stores empty, omission preserves.

opportunityId.description: Replacement opportunity; null clears, omission preserves.

assignedMemberId.description: Replacement assignee member; omission preserves, cannot clear here.

FunctionInput_lightfield_updatetask.description: A task ID and only the task fields or singular associations to change.

dueAt.description: Stored deadline in UTC Z or null.

status.description: Stored workflow status.

updatedAt.description: Update instant in UTC Z or null.

description.description: Stored Markdown or null.

FunctionOutput_lightfield_updatetask.description: Stored task values returned by Lightfield after the partial update; unavailable optional values are omitted.

tags.instructions: Use task IDs from `list-tasks` or `get-task`. Supply only changes; null clears optional description, deadline or associations. Use `delete-task` for trash and `restore-task` for recovery. Notes are read-only from the task side.
